criteria.action: Call plan with the exact fixture request and inspect the returned positions and missing count.
criteria.expected: Two positions match the stated coordinates in order and missing is zero; the scene is unchanged. (Tolerance: 1e-8 per coordinate)

criteria.requirement: two existing `Enemy` groups named `spawn-fixture-0` and `spawn-fixture-1` at the returned positions
criteria.action: Call loadFixture, update world matrices, and inspect the live scene graph and enemy world positions.
criteria.expected: Both named Enemy groups exist at the planned positions, fixture-block has the specified bounds, and fixture mode is active. (Tolerance: 1e-6 per world coordinate and 1e-6 per bound)

criteria.requirement: Reject it when it touches or enters an expanded obstacle
criteria.action: Plan candidates on each face, edge, and just outside the expanded fixture obstacle.
criteria.expected: Touching and interior candidates are rejected, while candidates epsilon outside the expanded bounds remain eligible. (Tolerance: Use test offsets of 1e-6)

criteria.action: Plan with occupied points at distances 1.499999, 1.5, and greater from an otherwise first-valid candidate.
criteria.expected: The first case rejects that candidate and the latter two permit it; separation also applies between successive planned enemies. (Tolerance: 1e-6 in XZ distance)

criteria.requirement: Throw `RangeError` for invalid input without changing lab state.
criteria.action: Submit negative counts, fractional counts or distances, reversed distances and bounds, NaN coordinates, and count 17.
criteria.expected: Every invalid request throws RangeError and getState remains deeply unchanged. (Tolerance: Exact state equality)

criteria.requirement: world-space XZ bounds of non-destroyed, non-passable meshes in `window.walls` as obstacles
criteria.action: Invoke ordinary spawnEnemies with controlled transformed wall meshes, a passable door, a destroyed wall, and living enemies.
criteria.expected: Only eligible solid wall bounds constrain placement, living enemies constrain separation, and no random fallback positions appear. (Tolerance: 1e-6 per resulting position)

criteria.requirement: it must not reset weapons, health, kills, buildings, or the player camera
criteria.action: Record those states, load and reset the fixture, then compare them and inspect fixture cleanup.
criteria.expected: All recorded game states are preserved, fixture objects are removed, and ordinary updating resumes. (Tolerance: Exact equality for scalars and object identity for preserved systems)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
